formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C x = decide (∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)) → PEqualNP.ReadK.IsReadK n C 1 → ∃ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ u2 v2 : Fin n, G.Adj u2 v2 → u2 ∈ T ∨ v2 ∈ T) ∧ G.edgeFinset.card + T.card ≤ C.size + 1)
plain_statement: It is false that: G has no 4-cycle. C has AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires, and computes the edge function of G (true exactly when both ends of some edge are true). C is read-1: every minimal set of inputs whose truth makes C true has a proof tree (all inputs at an AND gate, one at an OR gate) with each of its inputs as a leaf at most once. Then some vertex cover T of G has (number of edges) + |T| at most the number of gates plus 1; so C has at least |E| + tau - 1 gates, tau the least size of a vertex cover.
